claims: "Golden" from the Netflix animated film KPop Demon Hunters won Best Original Song at the 2026 Oscars.
"Golden" was performed by HUNTR/X (EJAE, Audrey Nuna, and Rei Ami).
"Golden" was co-written by EJAE, Mark Sonnenblick, Joong Gyu Kwak, Yu Han Lee, Hee Dong Nam, Jeong Hoon Seo, and Teddy Park.
"Golden" is the first K-pop song to win the Best Original Song Oscar.

The 2026 Best Original Song Oscar nominees were: WINNER "Golden" – KPop Demon Hunters, "I Lied to You" – Sinners, "Dear Me" – Diane Warren: Relentless, "Sweet Dreams of Joy" – Viva Verdi!, "Train Dreams" – Train Dreams.
"Golden" topped the Billboard Hot 100 for 18 weeks.
KPop Demon Hunters won Best Animated Feature at the 2026 Oscars.
